decisions.name: Source ownership
decisions.rationale: M3 is a read-only V2/Golden Thread/census projection; CODEx/QPS/ABACUS retain own authority.

decisions.name: Main merge vs governed admission
decisions.rationale: Historical M3 #667/#680 and ABACUS #2175/#2178/#2182/#2185 merges lack confirmed eligible independent human review; rules do not enforce required contexts.

decisions.name: Artifact delivery incident
decisions.rationale: REST artifacts API /zip not reliable direct browser link; original ZIP valid; M3 index requires HTTP, now offline standalone adapter proposed.

decisions.name: Canonical chat protocol
decisions.rationale: Use the existing cp_close.py intake, nine deterministic records and manifest rather than a competing handover producer.

decisions.name: Coverage and BD closure
decisions.rationale: Do not turn deduplicated ticket closures or different test populations into causal closures or coverage uplift.

insights.observation: Original M3 ZIP contained valid bytes and 24 entries, while the API browser link and file-scheme entrypoint were unusable in some clients.
insights.implication: QA must cover download/access and offline open, not only served-HTTP HTML.

insights.observation: M3 #667/#680 source merged while independent APPROVED review submissions were absent.
insights.implication: Green native QA and actual merge are separate from correctly governed acceptance.

insights.observation: ABACUS #2182 B0 run 39063903966 turned SUCCESS on exact PR head but previous Python matrix #2185 remained FAIL on a different first-red population.
insights.implication: Qualify serial source and first-red displacement per SHA, never infer full portfolio closure.
